set.body: Decision: Frame leaves ScalaFIM and becomes an independent repository at ~/code/scala/frame4s. Rename packages from scalafim.frame to frame4s and artifacts to frame4s-core/frame4s-fs2. Preserve the immutable typed plan, semantic interpreter, structured errors, JVM/Scala.js parity, and Resource ownership contracts exactly; extraction is mechanical plus standalone project infrastructure, not an API redesign. Use neutral initial publishing coordinates and describe Typelevel as a future affiliate application, not an existing affiliation or org.typelevel claim. Acceptance: remediation gates pass first; standalone repository has build, tests, Apache-2.0 license/provenance, README, CI, contribution/security/conduct posture, exact source provenance, and clean git history; all four focused JVM/JS gates pass in frame4s; ScalaFIM removes the duplicate modules/build aggregates/docs and points readers to frame4s without disturbing unrelated work.
set.title: Extract Frame into standalone frame4s repository
